{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nValues of customer_age == -1:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue column: is it string? any commas?
print("\nUnique revenue values (first 10):")
print(df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for QA orders
print("\nQA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nRefunded orders:", (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check channel distribution
print("\nChannel distribution:")
print(df['channel'].value_counts())

# Check customer_segment distribution
print("\nCustomer segment distribution:")
print(df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if channel and segment are confounded
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment']))"}
